strings.name: Joe Kaeser
strings.role: Former Siemens CEO; supervisory board chair of Siemens Energy and Daimler Truck
strings.summary: Joe Kaeser is a German industrial executive who joined Siemens in 1980 and worked in finance, strategy and group management, serving as president and CEO from 2013 to 2021. His subsequent work has focused on corporate oversight as supervisory board chair of Siemens Energy and Daimler Truck.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Siemens and Siemens Energy, management and supervisory boards, and announcement and effective dates are distinguished; future terms or strategic targets are not treated as completed facts.
strings.influence.rationale: Formerly led Siemens and participated in Siemens Energy governance, advancing structural changes in European industrial companies.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Studied business administration and obtained the Diplom-Betriebswirt (FH) qualification; it is not relabeled as an MBA or doctorate.
strings.facts.f2.label: Governance roles
strings.facts.f2.value: Currently chairs the supervisory boards of Siemens Energy and Daimler Truck Holding; these oversight positions differ from a CEO role.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Finance and strategy experience
strings.highlights.h1.text: He served successively as Siemens' chief strategy officer, chief financial officer and CEO, spanning group finance and industrial management.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Governance independence issues
strings.highlights.h2.text: A 2025 Siemens Energy release reported some investors' concerns about his independence and described strengthened responsibilities for the lead independent director.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Reelected to Daimler Truck supervisory board
strings.timeline.t1.text: The AGM materials confirm his reelection and continuation as supervisory board chair.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Reelected Siemens Energy supervisory board chair
strings.timeline.t2.text: Following the AGM elections, the supervisory board unanimously chose him to continue as chair at its subsequent meeting.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Steps down as Siemens CEO
strings.timeline.t3.text: Roland Busch succeeded him as president and CEO at the close of the annual shareholders' meeting.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Joins Siemens Energy supervisory board
strings.timeline.t4.text: The official CV specifies the start of his board membership; this is not used to infer the date of his first appointment as chair.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becomes Siemens president and CEO
strings.timeline.t5.text: He succeeded Peter Löscher; the appointment was announced on July 31.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Becomes Siemens CFO
strings.timeline.t6.text: He took responsibility for group finance after serving as chief strategy officer.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Becomes Siemens chief strategy officer
strings.timeline.t7.text: He moved from business and finance roles into group strategy, serving until 2006.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins Siemens
strings.timeline.t8.text: He began his career in the group, with early roles in semiconductor finance and business administration.
